messages:
Maya (Docs): Short thread to finalize relnotes for the docs deploy later today. Need: three user-facing bullets, any must-call-out known issues, and confirmation on SDK snippet rename + redirects. I'll open PR for the changelog in ~5m.
Eli (SDK): Snippet change: we standardized embeddings to `client.vectors.create(...)` across SDKs. Please replace old `client.embed()` demos in `reference/` and `examples/`. Example: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.vectors.create(model=\"vec-lite-v1\", input=[\"a\", \"b\"])\nprint(resp.vectors[0][:6])
```
Omar (Eng): Ops note: quantized backends can shift norms slightly; for teams using exact NN thresholds, call that out as a short known issue. Also we fixed a cache-eviction spike in runtime build 2026-03-20.
Nina (Product): Suggested 1-line marketing lead: "Smaller failovers, lower per-token cost, and simpler SDK migrations." Keep bullets punchy.
Maya (Docs): Draft bullets: - Graceful downgrade to compatible model variants under capacity pressure (fewer broken requests) - Optimize: batch-size & quantization suggestion panel in Optimize UI - Docs: consolidated v2 SDK examples and embedding API rename Known issue (one-liner): "Quantized embedding variants may change vector magnitudes; re-evaluate nearest-neighbor thresholds after upgrading."
deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled for 17:45 PT after PR merges. Will post results.
Eli (SDK): I'll open two PRs: snippets update + redirects. Will run linkcheck before merge.
Maya (Docs): Great, I'll shorten the changelog YAML and merge after staging smoke. Thanks! :sparkles:
